speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) how have HDB resale flat prices and cash-over-valuation trended over the last 12 months; and (b) what are the new measures that HDB will put in place to support families opting for resale flats in view of the prolonged completion of BTO flats due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Resale flats are generally available for immediate occupation and buyers can choose from a wide range of flats, according to their preferences and budget.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to monitor the market situation to ensure that it remains stable and sustainable.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: The need to get a flat urgently for young couples is significant and we also know that there is a significant delay because of COVID-19.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: For next year, we are still looking at demand and keeping track of the property market.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: We will announce the figures for next year's launch soon.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: We will assess each case on a case-by-case basis for their eligibility for rental housing or other forms of housing support.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And I urge the Member to raise any specific cases to us for our consideration.
